svg.title: Contribution board
svg.desc: Contribution board: the last year laid out as a printed circuit — twelve month-chips wired Jan→Dec into one data bus, each day a solder pad lit by that day's activity, with a gold edge connector. 1,384 commits, 180 active days, busiest May 17 with 55.

g.text: $ fab --board 12-layer # a month per chip, a day per pin
